violations.text: The door to the outside, located at the side door, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026
Large bags of rice and cases of food were observed stored on the floor in the pantry area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026
